response.justification: The candidate substantially exceeds the experience requirement with 15+ years of fullstack work, strong recent TypeScript/Node.js/React production experience, hands-on AI agent and MCP tooling work, and a demonstrable testing-first culture (TDD, test frameworks he authored, testing workshops). Cloud (AWS CDK), Kubernetes, Docker, MongoDB, and Java are all covered. Gaps are the lack of explicit Nest.js and Vitest/Jest experience and no Kotlin, but these are minor given the depth of adjacent skills. Note: the candidate currently works at re:cinq, which may warrant an internal conflict-of-interest check depending on the hiring context.
strengths: Deep, recent TypeScript/Node.js/React fullstack experience in production systems at scale
Direct AI agent development experience, including MCP code generators and agentic workflow frameworks
Strong testing and craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, authored test frameworks, taught testing courses)
concerns: No explicit Nest.js experience mentioned despite it being in the primary stack
Kotlin absent and Python not listed among skills, both named in required proficiencies
Significant career time invested in niche D-lang ecosystem, less transferable to the target stack
